outcome: Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSEP) and its complications
cohort: 43 women aged 30-40 years who presented with a Caesarean Scar Defect (CSD) at a tertiary care centre in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India, between February 2020 and February 2023.
finding: The majority of patients with CSD were 30-40 years old, with Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSEP) (74.4%) being the most common presentation, followed by Abnormal Uterine Bleeding (AUB) (18.6%) and secondary infertility (7%).
